description: Semantically analyze N already-produced model outputs for the SAME task (the MCP counterpart to the LLM Sandbox). Without a reference: computes consensus — pairwise cosine agreement, the most-representative output, and the outlier. With a `reference` (ground truth): also ranks every output by closeness (token cosine + ROUGE-L composite) and names the closest. No LLM, no key, runs locally. The reference mode is gate-able in CI; the consensus/outlier mode is a signal (no reference to fail against). You bring the outputs (2+). For a 2-way head-to-head with structural JSON diff use compare_responses instead.

reference.description: Optional ground-truth answer. If set, each output is also ranked by closeness to it and the closest one is named.

responses.description: The outputs to analyze (same task, N models/prompts/versions). Each item is a plain string or { "label": "GPT-4o", "text": "..." }. At least 2 required.

label.description: Human name for this candidate (e.g. model id)

name: analyze_responses
